ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution; estimated macro-level ratio of 95:5 (black:white) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity pigmentation across the central and medial lobe regions; distinct, high-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs concentrated exclusively at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression centered between the lobes with a wide interior angle (estimated 150 degrees) and low vertical bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edges exhibit low-frequency, low-amplitude undulations; lateral distal sections transition to high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks (2-5 pixel deviations) due to external encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge, transitioning from the central notch to upwardly swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel groups localized on the lateral extremities of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of barnacle colonies on the distal tips of the fluke, creating irregular textural margins and high-contrast pixel clusters.
